The '''Klatooine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and contained the planet [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]].
